hypothesis: Moving the frozen 493-byte C++ build-flag literal into the already compressed FCF source closure preserves effective build labels and reduces complete package size because the literal shares redundancy with the C++ closure.
interfaces_exposed: FCF source closure to deterministic build flag argument
kill_condition: Retire on nonpositive complete package delta, unsafe frame member, changed effective flags, or restored executable/dictionary mismatch.
promotion_condition: Require exact decoded closure, migrated literal, effective flags, executable and dictionary identity; delegate native archive, roundtrip, determinism, runtime, and memory to the minwrap successor.
title: B2 FCF build-literal migration
